en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika); The Triplet on Resultant (Vipākattika).

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-resultant, a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and resultant arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and of a nature not to result, a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and of a nature to result arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is visible and impinging, neither-result-nor-due-to-result, there arises a state that is visible and impinging, neither-result-nor-due-to-result, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one;
under predominance condition there are twenty-one … pe … under mutuality condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.
